## Checklist

- [ ] One change, branched from `main`.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Commit messages start with the area or a type: `pkg/config: ...`, `fix(cmd): ...`.
- [ ] A change users will notice has a line in `docs/releases/unreleased.md`.
- [ ] Goldens changed: said why above.
- [ ] First pull request: the [contributor agreement](../docs/contributing.md#contributor-agreement) is signed.
